metadata.title: The impact of the Galactic bar and the Large Magellanic Cloud on hypervelocity star trajectories

notes: No eligible stars. The paper analyzes large mock/simulated HVS populations (e.g., the ~23,000 selected unbound objects per catalog) and mock Gaia observations, but provides no individual real-star identifiers for those objects (T:p4-b9; T:p16-b6). Named HVSs in the text are contextual literature examples rather than stars selected or analyzed here as Galactic unbound candidates (T:p1-b9; T:p7-b7). Figure labels for representative HVSs are simulation labels, not individually identified observed stars (I:p8-b0).
